title: Can AI Forecast the Extremes? Evaluating Probabilistic Weather Models on Tropical Cyclones
abstract: arXiv:2610.22077v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weather prediction is undergoing an important shift, with data-driven AI models outperforming leading numerical weather prediction systems on average at a fraction of the computational cost. Yet, whether this success extends to extreme events remains contested. Earlier evaluations have exposed important shortcomings, but have largely focused on deterministic models and metrics, leaving the capabilities of the latest probabilistic models less understood. We conduct an extensive benchmark of tropical cyclone forecasting, comparing GenCast, FourCastNet 3, and FGN with ECMWF's operational physics-based ensemble, IFS-ENS. We develop a suite of probabilistic metrics and diagnostic analyses to assess cyclone tracking, intensity biases, uncertainty, and the wind-pressure relationship that characterizes storm structure. We find that, despite remaining limitations in intensity and ensemble spread, leading AI models substantially outperform IFS-ENS

translated_title: AI 能预报极端天气吗？评估概率天气模型在热带气旋上的表现
translated_abstract: 天气预报正经历一场重要变革，数据驱动的AI模型以极低的计算成本在平均表现上超越了领先的数值天气预报系统。然而，这种成功是否能延伸到极端事件仍存在争议。早期评估揭示了显著的不足，但主要集中在确定性模型和指标上，使得最新概率模型的能力尚不清晰。我们对热带气旋预报进行了广泛的基准测试，将GenCast、FourCastNet 3和FGN与ECMWF基于物理的业务集合预报系统IFS-ENS进行比较。我们开发了一套概率指标和诊断分析方法，用于评估气旋路径追踪、强度偏差、不确定性以及表征风暴结构的风-压关系。我们发现，尽管在强度和集合离散度方面仍存在局限，领先的AI模型大幅超越了IFS-ENS。
tldr: 通过对热带气旋预报开展广泛的概率基准评估，本研究发现尽管在强度和集合离散度方面仍有不足，以GenCast和FourCastNet 3为代表的领先AI模型在预报性能上大幅超越了ECMWF的业务集合预报系统IFS-ENS。
en_tdlr: Through an extensive probabilistic benchmark of tropical cyclone forecasting, this study shows that leading AI models such as GenCast and FourCastNet 3 substantially outperform ECMWF's operational IFS-ENS ensemble, despite remaining limitations in intensity and ensemble spread.
